name: Logos
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site customer logo strip (Webflow CMS collection list div-block-250, seen under the main content of the survey creator page), matched to the live ahaslides.com: a row of greyscale customer logos that loops left across the page. The logos are not typed into the markup; they come from marketing/data/logos-cms.json, the published CMS list recorded with its source URL and fetch date. An optional Trusted by teams at label can sit centred above the strip (off by default). Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Placement: on a page the Logos strip is always the band directly below the hero, never later in the page (Website composition rule and criterion W1)
Customer logo strip from the Webflow CMS, greyscale and looping left, matched to the live ahaslides.com at 1440px, 991px, 767px and 390px

Two backgrounds: White (the default) and Accent, the pale pink bgAccent surface laid over white by adding aha-logos--accent to the section; nothing in the section is pink-tinted, so no other change is needed

Logo list rendered from marketing/data/logos-cms.json (name, image URL, order), not hand-typed; the list is shown twice so the loop has no gap; images load eagerly so no logo is blank when it slides in

Slides left over 20s, linear, repeating, as the Webflow Infinite logo interaction does, but shifted by one set plus the gap so the loop restarts with no jump (live jumps 40px); stops under reduced motion
Logos are greyscale (saturate 0); 100px wide at most, 138px at 1920px; 50px tall at 991px and below, 75px tall at 479px and below (about 25% larger than live)
Second copy of the list is hidden from assistive technology; the strip has no hover or click behaviour, as on live
Where the logos are wider than the screen (767px and below) the set grows to its content, so logos no longer overlap the second copy as on live

Optional label (the Label switch): a centred Trusted by teams at line above the strip in the meta role of the type ramp (--aha-size-default, regular) and --aha-text-secondary, 32px above and 24px below; off by default, so the strip is unchanged until the aha-logos__label paragraph is added
